legend: Theofanis and his sister are playing the following game.

They have n$$$n$$$ points in a 2D plane and a starting point (sx,sy)$$$(s_x,s_y)$$$. Each player (starting from the first player) chooses one of the n$$$n$$$ points that wasn't chosen before and adds to the sum (which is initially 0$$$0$$$) the square of the Euclidean distance from the previous point (which is either the starting point or it was chosen by the other person) to the new point (that the current player selected).
The game ends after exactly n$$$n$$$ moves (after all the points are chosen). The first player wins if the sum is even in the end. Otherwise, the second player wins.

Theofanis is a very competitive person and he hates losing. Thus, he wants to choose whether he should play first or second. Can you show him, which player to choose, and how he should play to beat his sister?
input: The first line contains a single integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤2000$$$1 \le t \le 2000$$$) — the number of test cases.
The data for each test case is only available after the end of the interaction (the end of the game) for all previous test cases.
The first line of each test case contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤105$$$1 \le n \le 10^{5}$$$) — the number of points.
The second line of each test case contains two integers sx$$$s_x$$$, sy$$$s_y$$$ (0≤sx,sy≤109$$$0 \le s_x, s_y \le 10^{9}$$$) — the coordinates of the starting point.
Two or more points may have the same coordinates.
The i$$$i$$$-th of the following n$$$n$$$ lines contains two integers xi$$$x_i$$$ and yi$$$y_i$$$ (0≤xi,yi≤109$$$0 \le x_i, y_i \le 10^{9}$$$) — the coordinates of the i$$$i$$$-th point.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 105$$$10^{5}$$$.
For each test case, you should first output the player that you want to play as (First or Second).

Then, you should play the game. When it's your turn, you should output the index j$$$j$$$ (1≤j≤n$$$1 \le j \le n$$$) of the point that you want to choose, and when it's the other player's turn, you should read the index that they choose.
When all the turns are done, continue with reading the input for the next test case, or finish the program, if there are none.

If you receive the integer −1$$$-1$$$ instead of an index or a valid value of n$$$n$$$, it means your program has made an invalid move or has lost the game in the previous test case. Your program must terminate immediately to receive a Wrong Answer verdict. Otherwise, you can get an arbitrary verdict because your solution will continue to read from a closed stream.
After printing a choice for a player, or a turn, do not forget to output the end of line and flush the output. Otherwise, you will get Idleness limit exceeded. To do this, use:
fflush(stdout) or cout.flush() in C++;
System.out.flush() in Java;
flush(output) in Pascal;
stdout.flush() in Python;
see the documentation for other languages.
Hacks
To hack, use the following format.
The first line contains a single integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤2000$$$1 \le t \le 2000$$$) — the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤105$$$1 \le n \le 10^{5}$$$) — the number of points.
The second line of each test case contains two integers sx$$$s_x$$$, sy$$$s_y$$$ (0≤sx,sy≤109$$$0 \le s_x, s_y \le 10^{9}$$$) — the coordinates of the starting point.
The i$$$i$$$-th of the following n$$$n$$$ lines contains two integers xi$$$x_i$$$ and yi$$$y_i$$$ (0≤xi,yi≤109$$$0 \le x_i, y_i \le 10^{9}$$$) — the coordinates of the i$$$i$$$-th point.
The sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases should not exceed 105$$$10^{5}$$$.

legend.ai: Theofanis 和他的妹妹正在进行如下游戏。
他们在二维平面上有 n$$$n$$$ 个点，以及一个起点 (sx,sy)$$$(s_x,s_y)$$$。每位玩家(从第一位玩家开始)选择一个之前尚未被选择的 n$$$n$$$ 个点，并将从前一个点(即起点或由另一位玩家选择的点)到当前玩家所选新点的欧氏距离的平方加到总和中(总和初始为 0$$$0$$$)。
游戏恰好进行 n$$$n$$$ 步后结束(所有点都被选中)。如果最终总和为偶数，则第一位玩家获胜；否则，第二位玩家获胜。
Theofanis 竞争心很强，他讨厌失败。因此，他想选择自己应该先手还是后手。你能告诉他应该选择哪位玩家的位置，以及如何进行游戏来击败他的妹妹吗？

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 t$$$t$$$(1≤t≤2000$$$1 \le t \le 2000$$$)——测试用例的数量。
对于每个测试用例，只有在所有之前的测试用例的交互结束（游戏结束）后，才能获得其数据。
每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤105$$$1 \le n \le 10^{5}$$$)——点的数量。
每个测试用例的第二行包含两个整数 sx$$$s_x$$$、sy$$$s_y$$$(0≤sx,sy≤109$$$0 \le s_x, s_y \le 10^{9}$$$)——起点的坐标。
可能存在两个或多个点具有相同的坐标。
以下 n$$$n$$$ 行中的第 i$$$i$$$ 行包含两个整数 xi$$$x_i$$$ 和 yi$$$y_i$$$(0≤xi,yi≤109$$$0 \le x_i, y_i \le 10^{9}$$$)——第 i$$$i$$$ 个点的坐标。
保证所有测试用例中 n$$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 105$$$10^{5}$$$。
对于每个测试用例，你应首先输出你想要扮演的玩家（First 或 Second）。
然后，你应进行游戏。在你的回合中，你应输出你想选择的点的编号 j$$$j$$$(1≤j≤n$$$1 \le j \le n$$$)；在另一位玩家的回合中，你应读入其选择的编号。
当所有回合结束后，继续读入下一个测试用例的输入；如果没有下一个测试用例，则结束程序。
如果你收到整数 −1$$$-1$$$，而不是点的编号或有效的 n$$$n$$$ 值，这意味着你的程序在上一个测试用例中进行了无效操作或输掉了游戏。你的程序必须立即终止，以获得 Wrong Answer 判定。否则，由于你的解法会继续从已关闭的流中读取数据，你可能会得到任意判定。
为某位玩家输出选择或一个回合后，不要忘记输出换行并刷新输出。否则，你将获得 Idleness limit exceeded。要做到这一点，请使用：
在 C++ 中使用 fflush(stdout) 或 cout.flush()；
在 Java 中使用 System.out.flush()；
在 Pascal 中使用 flush(output)；
在 Python 中使用 stdout.flush()；
其他语言请参阅相应文档。

若要 hack，请使用以下格式。

每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤105$$$1 \le n \le 10^{5}$$$)，表示点的数量。
每个测试用例的第二行包含两个整数 sx$$$s_x$$$ 和 sy$$$s_y$$$(0≤sx,sy≤109$$$0 \le s_x, s_y \le 10^{9}$$$)，表示起点的坐标。
接下来的 n$$$n$$$ 行中，第 i$$$i$$$ 行包含两个整数 xi$$$x_i$$$ 和 yi$$$y_i$$$(0≤xi,yi≤109$$$0 \le x_i, y_i \le 10^{9}$$$)，表示第 i$$$i$$$ 个点的坐标。
所有测试用例的 n$$$n$$$ 之和不应超过 105$$$10^{5}$$$。
